templates.name: Attendance Ledger
templates.description: Monthly class attendance register — 20 roll-wise student rows × 31 day columns with P/A/L marks and present/absent totals. Bulk-generate per class + BS month with real attendance records (one page per 20 students).

autofill.notes: Roll/name rows map to {roll_N}/{name_N}; the day grid fills each {m_<row>_<day>} with P, A, L (late), H (half-day), Lv (leave) or blank when no attendance record exists, and {total_p_N}/{total_a_N} carry the row totals. Bulk: pick class + BS month — 20 students per A4 page, attendance marks come from the month's attendance records.
